thread:
emma: quick thought: UX for fallback sampling needs a "tiny forensic" preset that bites only during incidents.
rafael: +1. tiny forensic = baseline 0.01% + incident bump to 10% for 30m.
priya: we should let users opt-in to capture full payload per-tenant; default off. add "hash identifiers" toggle.
emma: console placement: show sampling under each rule with a compact cost estimate (per-hour). clicking opens advanced adaptive controls.
rafael: backend: sampling decision must be emitted in X-Audit-Decision header before tokenization. that avoids extra work on dropped samples.
priya: security: captured payloads must be encrypted and retention default 7d. require tenant approval for longer retention.
ops-bot: scheduled smoke test: audit-sample-tiny at 2025-01-12T02:00:00Z. will post metrics.
emma: next steps: emma mockup tiny preset, rafael will draft header + proto, priya will flag redaction rules. reconvene Friday.
